name: g3b-education
description: G3B Education - full-stack website (React + Vite client, Express + MySQL API)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
